Subject: Security briefing rendezvous + evidence lane selection

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday. Finacus moving into procurement is great — we want to make the SOC 2 / pen-test / DPA walkthrough as frictionless as possible. To that end, can we lock a 30–45 minute rendezvous next week where we: 

- run a compact SOC 2 controls overview (15 minutos)
- confirm pen-test scope & timeline (10 minutos)
- hand off the evidence lane and map where artifacts will be dropped (10–20 minutos)

Proposed times (PT): Tue 9/14 09:00–09:45, Wed 9/15 16:00–16:45, Thu 9/16 08:30–09:15. We can provide a short agenda (I attached a draft) and the SOC2-evidence-map.xlsx as an artifacts cheat-sheet.

Please tell us which slot works best and who from Finacus should be on the call (security, legal, procurement). If none of these fit, happy to swap to an evening APAC-friendly window — just let me know.

Best,
Rohan

Hi Rohan — thanks for the clear options and the attachments. 

A few notes from our side before we lock a time: 
- Procurement would like a short vendor questionnaire answered prior to the call (I attached a checklist PDF they send out).
- Our security lead (Marco) prefers an afternoon slot; he’s in PT.
- We typically reserve 45 minutes for combined SOC2 + pen-scope so we don’t rush questions.

Wed 9/15 16:00–16:45 PT works best for Marco and procurement. Could you confirm Monica or Mateo will cover the controls overview and where you expect us to drop artifacts (S3 link or shared Drive)? Also, can you post the HubSpot deal link in the calendar invite so procurement can reference the pricing terms during the touchpoint?

Thanks,

- Monica will run the SOC 2 controls overview and evidence lane map.
- Mateo will cover pen-test scope and intake for vendor testers (including timing and our standard safe harbor).

Sending invite now.
